thread:
sam: quick ask — need temporary IAM attach to an ecs task role to repro a secret fetch failure in a prod-like stack. Can I get JIT for 1h? ticket INC-2345

linda: what's the minimal scope you need? don't want full admin.

sam: need iam:PassRole on arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ecs-debug-role and sts:AssumeRole on the service-account role. Scope: cluster=prod-ecs-east, single task.

maria: please post justification + exact start/end times, the commands you'll run, and a short cleanup plan. also say if you'll copy any logs out.

sam: plan: run a one-off task with role override to reproduce the 403 during secret fetch, capture /var/log/app/errors.log and the stack trace, then tear down. Start 2026-03-18T15:00Z for 60m. command i'll run:
```
aws ecs run-task --cluster prod-ecs-east --task-definition debug:1 --overrides '{"containerOverrides":[{"name":"app","environment":[{"name":"DEBUG","value":"1"}]}]}'
```
no secrets will be saved locally; will paste redacted logs to the ticket. will rotate any secret if it looks impacted.

maria: tagging ops-oncall for authorization. we'll open JIT in IAM for this. remember to avoid pasting raw secrets, redact PII.

ops-oncall: oncall here — +1 for 60m. make sure no long-lived creds are created. create a change ticket and the JIT link before starting. i'll approve once JIT request is visible.

sam: created change CHG-9876 and JIT request JIT-5432. note: read-only secret read, non-prod-data snapshot, reproducible error.

maria: approving JIT-5432 for 60m. audit-bot will record session details. @linda fyi you may see assume-role activity in CloudTrail.

linda: noted. after run, paste exact commands + timestamps here, and confirm you terminated the task. redact any user identifiers.

audit-bot: elevation logged: user=sam, role=ecs-debug-role, start_ts=2743216840, duration_s=3600, request_id=JIT-5432.

sam: starting run now, will report back asap.

sam: reproduced error — getting 403 when fetching secret; attached redacted gist: https://gist.github.com/abcd1234 (contains trimmed stack, no secrets). cleaned up task, revoked session.

maria: thanks. please confirm you rotated the secret if you touched it and that no AWS_ACCESS_KEY was left in env. i'll close CHG-9876 after confirmation.

sam: confirmed: no AWS_ACCESS_KEY in task env, task stopped, secret rotated (arn redacted). closing CHG-9876 and JIT session. thanks all.

maria: logged — closing. short note for runbook: prefer role-override + ephemeral role next time, and always attach a JIT link in the ticket.
